items.title: Nvidia Vs. AMD: No, Neither is Getting Choked Out By Congress Come January
items.summary: Record AI quarters have NVIDIA and AMD staring down a Congress eager to police where advanced chips can go. One of them already wrote China out of its forecast, and the other still has more to lose than its growth curve suggests.

items.title: Google and Meta fight new rule that could change online news
items.summary: The bill would require digital platforms to compensate news publishers for displaying content links and introduce rules covering AI.

items.summary: AI agentic shopping is bringing more risk to e-commerce merchants. Riskified has a plan to combat that risk.

items.title: Meta infrastructure chief Santosh Janardhan to step down in early 2027 - Bloomberg
items.summary: Investing.com -- Meta Platforms Inc's (NASDAQ:META) longtime infrastructure chief and engineering co-head Santosh Janardhan will step down in early 2027, marking a pivotal executive transition as the social media giant accelerates its massive artificial intelligence buildout. According to an internal memo obtained by Bloomberg News, Janardhan plans to hand operational leadership of the division to Dave Brown, a former Amazon Web Services executive who joined Meta earlier this year.

items.title: Many AI companies will adopt advertising: Criteo CEO
items.summary: Many AI platforms will end up eventually adopting advertising, the chief executive of the online advertising agency Criteo told AFP Tuesday, as investors are focused on whether the technology will ever be profitable."I believe that a lot of AI platforms will find their way to advertising models over time," said the group's chief executive Michael Komasinski on the sidelines of the Web Summit in Lisbon.
